methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $15M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.0x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
zeroRISC is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Dominic Rizzo that has raised $15M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, and SambaNova Systems, though none provide sufficient overlap for a narrow peer median calculation.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proves applicable. Using total capital raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied value of $38M. This method is grounded in observed progression patterns rather than market multiples. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied without zeroRISC's revenue (a constraint typical for early-stage privates), though the sector median P/S of 21.0x across the three public semiconductors establishes context for valuation expansion once the company reaches revenue scale. Peer-Median analysis was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $32M to $43M, with a median point of $38M. This reflects a modest premium to total capital raised, consistent with Seed progression norms. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue metrics, limited private peer comparability at identical stage, and the company's specific technology differentiation relative to the broader semiconductor landscape.
